faqs.a:
Pursuant to C.R.S. § 31-16-101 et seq. and the Arvada City Charter, the National Electrical
               Code, 2023 Edition, including Annexes A through K, published by the National Fire
               Protection Association, is hereby adopted by reference and incorporated into the Arvada
               City Code. The 2023 National Electrical Code shall be known as the "N.E.C." or the
               "electrical code," and may be cited and referred to as such. Any reference in any
               of the technical codes to the International Code Council Electrical Code shall be
               to the most nearly equivalent of the 2023 National Electrical Code, or any successor
               electrical code adopted by Arvada.
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 14, 9-14-2020; Ord. No.
4843
, § 1, 5-15-2023)
